name: better-markdown-preview
description: A better, theme-aware Markdown preview for Visual Studio Code.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.taskList.description: Render GFM task lists. When disabled, task-list syntax is delegated to VS Code and other Markdown extensions.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.definiti.description: Render definition lists. When disabled, definition-list syntax is delegated to VS Code and other Markdown extensions.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.footnote.description: Render footnotes and backlinks. When disabled, footnote syntax is delegated to VS Code and other Markdown extensions.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.githubAl.description: Render GitHub-style alerts. When disabled, alert syntax is delegated to VS Code and other Markdown extensions.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.emojiSho.description: Render named emoji shortcodes such as :joy: as Unicode emoji.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.emoticon.description: Render emoticon shortcuts such as :) as Unicode emoji when named emoji shortcodes are enabled.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.tomlFron.description: Render TOML frontmatter as an expanded, collapsible, syntax-highlighted code block. When disabled, TOML frontmatter is delegated to VS Code and other Markdown extensions.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.yamlFron.description: Render YAML frontmatter as an expanded, collapsible, syntax-highlighted code block. When disabled, YAML frontmatter is delegated to VS Code and other Markdown extensions.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.columns.description: Render responsive Pandoc-style columns. When disabled, column syntax is delegated to VS Code and other Markdown extensions.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.enhanced.description: Fill missing GFM HTTP, HTTPS, email, and www literal links after VS Code's native linkifier.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.richCode.description: Render code-block titles, highlighting, line numbers, word emphasis, and diff annotations.

betterMarkdownPreview.rendering.mermaid.description: Render exact lowercase Mermaid fences. When disabled, Mermaid fences are delegated to VS Code and other Markdown extensions.

betterMarkdownPreview.navigation.tableOf.description: Show the responsive table of contents and active-heading tracking.

betterMarkdownPreview.navigation.smoothS.description: Animate table-of-contents navigation when reduced motion is not requested.

betterMarkdownPreview.mermaid.viewer.description: Enable the full-screen zoom and pan viewer for rendered Mermaid diagrams.

scripts.compile: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.mts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.test:contracts: node --test test/commands.test.mts test/harness.test.mts test/manifest.test.mts test/presentation.test.mts test/release.test.mts test/workflows.test.mts
scripts.test:hosts:prepare: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:host-runners
scripts.test:extension: pnpm run test:hosts:prepare && pnpm run test:desktop:floor && pnpm run test:desktop:stable
